text:
You need a mobile app for Android and iOS that works with ChatGPT on eyewear, accepts voice commands through Siri and Google Assistant, and returns NLP output reliably.  

I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning developer with 6 years of experience building Python-based AI systems. For this kind of voice-driven, cross-platform assistant, I can help design the flow from speech input to intent handling to ChatGPT response generation, with a focus on clean orchestration, fast response times, and a smooth user experience across mobile and wearable use cases.

I’ve built production AI assistants using Python, OpenAI API, LangChain, and FastAPI. One relevant project was a contract clause search assistant for the legal industry. It answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. That system achieved faithfulness of 0.91 on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and it reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.  

I also built a delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It handled WhatsApp and SMS conversations, tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context. That assistant resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and reached CSAT 4.4 out of 5.

For your project, I would focus on:
- voice-command flow design for Siri and Google Assistant
- ChatGPT integration for generating the NLP output
- backend orchestration for request handling and response formatting
- reliable prompt and conversation management
- building the mobile app experience for Android and iOS compatibility

My background also includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, so I can contribute both to the application layer and the AI logic behind it.

If you’d like, I can help map out the architecture for the voice assistant flow and define the core interactions needed for eyewear use.
